title: Chicken Piccata
description: Thin-pounded cutlets, dredged and seared until the crust turns gold, finished in a bright, buttery pan sauce of lemon, capers, and white wine.

image.alt: Chicken basting in butter in a dark skillet with charred lemon halves

ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, halved and pounded to 6mm
Fine sea salt and black pepper
steps: Season the cutlets with salt and pepper, then dredge in flour, shaking off the excess.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil and 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the cutlets in batches, 2–3 minutes per side, until golden. Set aside.
Add the remaining oil to the pan, pour in the wine, and scrape up the browned bits. Simmer 2 minutes to cook off the alcohol.
Add the stock, capers, and lemon juice. Simmer 4–5 minutes until slightly reduced.
Off the heat, whisk in the remaining 2 tbsp butter until the sauce turns glossy.
Return the chicken to the pan, spoon the sauce over, and simmer 2 minutes to warm through. Finish with parsley.
note: Pound the cutlets to an even thickness — uneven pieces mean thin edges overcook before the center is done.
